World four where the game goes from okay to great because of elite classes.
Save your eggs for the time being.

Build a roster of six pets to fight for higher spices and do the arena unlocking at level eight.

Using three eggs is fine early but don't use more.
Buy upgrade stones every day.
Buy three and seven lab edition chips; they restock daily and unlock new lab mechanics when consumed.
Buy six splicers as free stat sticks with 10 defense; splicing explained later.
Buy three extra stamps from the shop.

Buy out kitchens since they speed things up.

Once a day lowest level bubble levels up a set amount; the noob neglect bonus.

A lab bonus lets you place all shrines in town and affect everyone.

Get lab to level 75 minimum for line width and to unlock 75 max chips on console.
Jewels are guaranteed new while chips are a gamble; don't spend gems on them if avoidable.
Souped up lab tubes, richland kitchen and the egg are pretty strong gem purchases.
Infinity hammer is a must; about four on brimstone slots is fine.
Skip cauldrons for now but buy at least one bleach cauldron.

Build slots maybe if cooking; brackets are useless since they're one and done.

Only a few dungeon boosters to get times 20 per week.
Don't buy time candy with gems.
Shop cards mostly avoid except later world six cards.

Put everyone in lab; it is a long grind that must be done.
